svg.title: Adaptive compaction compared with the original efficiency score

cc:Work.dc:title: Adaptive compaction compared with the original efficiency score
cc:Work.dc:description: Native user-space compressed-segment compaction; 5 paired trials per policy and scenario. Comparisons with efficiency; percentages are medians of 100*(1-policy/reference), not ratios of medians. All 14 scenario/quota combinations and four corpora are shown, including regressions. Full-target controls require identical bytes moved and released. Selection scans are included. Synthetic deletion layouts, repeated source data, no production generalization or macOS-kernel claim. Source results/compaction-adaptive-2026-10-30/all-results.json; SHA-256 335d0eb0199e83f56297cd5a02b3a9afc7becbf461382d58e0f4d23dfa69077a. Rendered with Matplotlib 3.10.9.
